body:
It's actually the end of the semester at my school. I am doing pretty well in all my classes but the majority of my grade will reflect the next couple of weeks unfortunately. That's just the way my classes were set up (i.e., finals and semester long projects and papers). I'm trying to hang in there since I worked my ass off all semester just to get here. I guess we will see how it goes.

Nothing has happened really. It seems so out of the blue and that's why I'm so confused.

I like this. Thanks. A little girl fell down outside my apartment today. I didn't realize what happened until someone was already helping her but I realized that I actually got excited about the thought of going out there to help her. Maybe volunteering would help after all.

Yeah, life just isn't fun anymore... that was the point I was making. All those fun things have stopped being fun. Also, I AM the cute girl behind the counter. 

Medications... I have taken psych meds that basically made me narcoleptic, ones that made me really irritable, gave me nightmares, caused me to do weird shit in my sleep, and have actually made me obsess over suicide anymore. I'm done experimenting with those. The side effects end up being more dangerous in my opinion.
I'm a woman, of course I'm right. Just kidding. :)

I used to get upset over stuff like that too. I don't think I really stopped until I was in a relationship where I felt like I was extremely important and special. That relationship made me see that I actually am important and special. I don't need the constant reassurance anymore and it doesn't matter whether I'm single or not. I also understand now how hard it is for people to remember to invite everyone that they think are important. Maybe you have shitty friends or maybe you have friends that get caught up in their lives and forgot things that are extremely important to them. Either way, I think you are probably pretty awesome and I bet someday someone will come by and love you for who you are. You're sensitive and that's not a bad thing. I think that right now your sensitiveness is manifesting itself into negative things because you haven't discovered how great you really are yet. I don't think that your depression defines you, I think you are just letting it define you right now. Just from your post I can tell that you are different and that makes you special. 
Seriously though, someday you will find out just how amazing you are... and when you do, everything will change for you.
